mapper.sql: id, user_id, kb_id, query, document_id, seq, passage_sha256, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kb_eval_labels (user_id, kb_id, query, document_id, seq, passage_sha256) VALUES (#{userId}, #{kbId}, #{query}, #{documentId}, #{seq}, #{passageSha256}) AS new ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE document_id = new.document_id, seq = new.seq, passage_sha256 = new.passage_sha256, updated_at = NOW(6)
